== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|The [[Abidan]] [[Court]] is a powerful organization dedicated to maintaining order across various worlds and protecting them from the encroaching chaos of the Void. Originating from the world of [[Cradle]], where the first generation of the [[Court]] of Seven ascended, the organization operates through a hierarchy that includes high-ranking [[Judges]] and specialized roles such as [[Executors]]. The [[Court]] is led by seven [[Judges]], including figures like Ozriel, [[Makiel]], and Judge Suriel{{!}}Suriel, who oversee vast sectors of existence. Their primary mission involves stabilizing worlds, quarantining important locations like [[Haven]], [[Sanctum]], and [[Asylum]] to prevent total system collapse, and managing Way{{!}}the Way to ensure consistent physics and causality. While their goal is to preserve life and order, the [[Abidan]] are often viewed as inflexible tyrants or jailers by those they govern. Their methods can involve extreme actions that others might classify as war crimes, and they strictly enforce regulations regarding the manipulation of Fate{{!}}fate and power. The organization recruits talented individuals who have ascended beyond their home iterations, using various methods across different worlds to swell their ranks. Despite their immense Authority{{!}}authority and resources—including powerful artifacts like the [[Razor]] and Worldseeds—the [[Court]] faces significant threats from enemies such as the [[Vroshir]] and former members like [[Daruman]], who became The Mad King{{!}}the Mad King in an effort to dismantle their rule.}}
